    Metamodel and Project API Reference¶

    Metamodel¶

    The NewSEGS Metamodel (Metamodel) is a container for a "configuration" of Energy Model, Finance Model, and the Variables which parameterise them. It provides methods for serialisation and deserialisation, including or excluding its associated Model and Finance instances.

    A reduced quantity of information capable of identifying the metamodel and its key characteristics can be contained in a Python dictionary referred to as a config. This contains the name of the Metamodel and unique identifiers for itself, its associated Model, and its associated Finance.

    Provisions¶

    The Metamodel provides methods for the following:

    • Parameter synchronisation
      • Updating a Metamodel held Variable given its identifying characteristics and new value
      • Updating a Model or Finance parameter with the deterministic value of a held Variable.
      • Updating the Model or Finance parameters where the deterministic value of the associated Variables have changed.
    • Config
      • Generation of a new config
      • Production of a config correct for the current instance.

    Metamodels: the unit that is configured, run and analysed.

    A metamodel binds a NewSEGS Energy Model, a finance model and the variables that characterise their parameters, and runs them together. See NewsegsMetaModel for the details of what it holds and the states it can be put in.

    NewsegsMetaModel ¶

    Bases: TableOwningNewsegsComponent

    A container and controller for models and variables.

    Principally, a NewsegsMetaModel holds:

    • A reference to a NewsegsModel
    • A reference to a NewsegsFinance which itself references the NewsegsModel
    • A series of Variables which locate the values in the NewsegsModel and NewsegsFinance
    • An OptimComponent holding the method and statistic of optimisation

    The metamodel can be set into a state:

    • Deterministic run
    • Deterministic probability analysis
    • Probabilistic sensitivity analysis

    Its state is used to control the behaviour of its Variables and to propagate live values into its NewsegsModel and NewsegsFinance. These models can then be run and values extracted.

    For a dsa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond to a change in a single Variable.

    For a psa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond to a sample across all enabled PSA variables.

    class NewsegsMetaModel(TableOwningNewsegsComponent):
    """A container and controller for models and variables.

    Principally, a NewsegsMetaModel holds:

    - A reference to a NewsegsModel
    - A reference to a NewsegsFinance which itself references the NewsegsModel
    - A series of Variables which locate the values in the NewsegsModel and
      NewsegsFinance
    - An OptimComponent holding the method and statistic of optimisation

    The metamodel can be set into a state:

    - Deterministic run
    - Deterministic probability analysis
    - Probabilistic sensitivity analysis

    Its state is used to control the behaviour of its Variables and to propagate
    live values into its NewsegsModel and NewsegsFinance. These models can then be
    run and values extracted.

    For a dsa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a
    dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond
    to a change in a single Variable.

    For a psa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a
    dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond
    to a sample across all enabled PSA variables.
    """

    model_id: str
    finance_id: str
    checked_out: bool = False

    _name = 'Configuration'
    _version = '0.1.0'
    _id_prefix = COMPONENT_PREFIXES['metamodel']
    _last_modified: datetime.datetime = datetime.datetime.now()

    _excluded_attributes = NewsegsComponent._excluded_attributes.union({'_watcher'})

    last_dsa_run: float = 0.
    last_psa_run: float = 0.
    last_optim_run: float = 0.

    model = ComponentProperty(default = None, oftype = NewsegsModelInterface)
    finance = ComponentProperty(default = None, oftype = NewsegsFinanceInterface)
    optim_config = ComponentProperty(default = OptimComponent, oftype = OptimComponent)
    """The optimisation settings; a metamodel saved without them is given the defaults."""

    variables = TableModifyingComponentOrderedDictProperty(oftype = variable.Variable)
    _variables_last_model_sync: dict
    """The revision number of the variable at last deterministic sync."""

    @override
    def _generate_config(self, *args, **kwargs) -> NewsegsMetaModelConfig:
        return NewsegsMetaModelConfig(*args, **kwargs)
    _config: NewsegsMetaModelConfig # pyright: ignore[reportIncompatibleVariableOverride]

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: NewsegsModelInterface,
        finance: NewsegsFinanceInterface,
        variables: MutableSequence[variable.Variable] = [],
        table_config: Optional[TableConfigNewsegsComponent] = None,
        optim_config: Optional[OptimComponent] = None,
        **kwargs
    ):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)

        self.table_config = table_config or TableConfigNewsegsComponent()
        self.optim_config = optim_config or OptimComponent()
        self.watcher = MMVarWatcher(self)

        self.model = model
        self.finance = finance

        self.variables = {variable.variable_uid(x):x for x in variables}
        self._variables_last_model_sync = {}

    @property
    def watcher(self) -> RevisionNotifierProtocol:
        """The watcher which tracks changes to the variables; created on first use.
        """
        if self._watcher is None:
            self._watcher = MMVarWatcher(self)
        return self._watcher

    @watcher.setter
    def watcher(self, watcher: RevisionNotifierProtocol):
        self._watcher = watcher

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `reattach_model` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def reattach_model(
        self,
        model_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsModelInterface]
    ) -> None:
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsModel instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            model_provider: Mapping of model IDs to NewsegsModel instances.

        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated model ID.
            ValueError: If model_provider cannot provide the model.
            TypeError: If the provided object is not a NewsegsModel.
        """
        if not hasattr(self, '_model_id') or self._model_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('this MetaModel has no associated model to reattach.')
        mdl = model_provider.get(self._model_id)
        if mdl is None:
            raise ValueError(f'model_provider could not provide model for key {self._model_id}')
        if not isinstance(mdl, NewsegsModelInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'model_provider did not provide a NewsegsModel for key {self._model_id} - {type(mdl)} returned instead')
        self.model = mdl
        try:
            if self.finance is not None:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model)
        except AttributeError:
            pass

    def reattach_em(self, em_provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsModel instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        """
        r0 = self.revision
        if not hasattr(self, '_model_id') or self._model_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('This MetaModel has no associated model to reattach.')
        mdl = em_provider.get_component(self._model_id)
        if not isinstance(mdl, NewsegsModelInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'em_provider did not provide a NewsegsModel for key {self._model_id}')
        self.model = mdl
        try:
            if self.finance is not None:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        self.revision = r0

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `reattach_finance` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def reattach_finance(self, finance_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsFinanceInterface]) -> None:
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsFinance instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            finance_provider: Mapping of finance IDs to NewsegsFinance instances.

        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated finance ID.
            ValueError: If finance_provider cannot provide the finance.
            TypeError: If the provided object is not a NewsegsFinance.
        """
        r0 = self.revision
        if not hasattr(self, '_finance_id') or self._finance_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('this MetaModel has no associated finance to reattach.')
        fnc = finance_provider.get(self._finance_id)
        if fnc is None:
            raise ValueError(f'finance_provider could not provide finance for key {self._finance_id}')
        if not isinstance(fnc, NewsegsFinanceInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'finance_provider did not provide a NewsegsFinance for key {self._finance_id} - {type(fnc)} returned instead')
        self.finance = fnc
        if self.model is not None:
            self.finance.set_model(self.model, dirty = False)
        self.revision = r0

    def reattach_fm(self, fm_provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsFinance instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        """
        r0 = self.revision
        if not hasattr(self, '_finance_id') or self._finance_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('This MetaModel has no associated finance to reattach.')
        fnc = fm_provider.get_component(self._finance_id)
        if not isinstance(fnc, NewsegsFinanceInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'fm_provider did not provide a NewsegsFinance for key {self._finance_id}')
        self.finance = fnc
        try:
            if self.model is not None:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model, False)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        self.revision = r0

    # def get_component_attributes(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    #     atts = super().get_component_attributes()
    #     return ('table_config', *atts)

    @property
    def variable_ids(self) -> tuple[dict[str, str], ...]:
        # As variables cannot exist until table_config has been reattached,
        # only search for _variable_ids during child uid update
        """The varid and the id of each variable of the metamodel.
        """
        if self.table_config is None:
            return getattr(self, '_variable_ids', ())
        if len(self.variables) == 0 and hasattr(self, '_variable_ids'):
            return self._variable_ids
        return tuple(
            {
                'varid': k,
                'uid': x.id
            } for k, x in self.variables.items()
        )

    def reattach_variables(self, variable_provider: VariableProviderInterface) -> None:
        """Reattach any associated Variables after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            variable_provider: Instance of VariableProviderInterface (typically a Project).
        """
        these_vars = self.variable_ids
        r0 = self.revision
        tr0 = self.table_config.revision
        vr0 = self.variables.revision # type: ignore
        for var_identifiers in these_vars:
            try:
                v = variable_provider.get_variable(var_identifiers['uid'])
            except KeyError:
                v = variable_provider.get_default_variable(var_identifiers['varid'])
            self.variables[var_identifiers['varid']] = v
        self.variables.revision = vr0 # type: ignore
        self.revision = r0
        self.table_config.revision = tr0


    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `reattach_table_config` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def reattach_table_config(self, component_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsComponent]):
        """Reattach the associated TableConfig instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            component_provider: Mapping of component IDs to NewsegsComponent instances.
        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated table config ID.
            ValueError: If component_provider cannot provide the table config.
            TypeError: If the provided object is not a TableConfigNewsegsComponent.
        """
        if not hasattr(self, '_table_config_id') or self._table_config_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('This MetaModel has no associated TableConfig to reattach.')
        tc = component_provider.get(self._table_config_id)
        if tc is None:
            raise ValueError(f'component_provider could not provide table config for key {self._table_config_id}')
        if not isinstance(tc, TableConfigNewsegsComponent):
            raise TypeError(f'component_provider did not provide a TableConfigNewsegsComponent for key {self._table_config_id}')
        self.table_config = tc

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `update_variable_from_interface` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def update_variable_from_interface(
        self,
        section: str,
        key: str,
        subindex: int,
        parameter_index: int,
        vector_location: int,
        value: variable.ScalarParam
    ) -> tuple[bool, bool, bool, bool, tuple[variable.Param,...]]:
        """
        Update the addressed variable with the new value.

        The Variable is addressed by {section}.{key}.{subindex} in the 
        .variables OrderedDict. After identifying the variable, the nominated 
        parameter index is updated with the scalar value; if the parameter is
        an array type, it is addressed by its location in the flattened array
        using the vector_location.

        Args:
            section: Interface section.
            key: Variable specifier.
            subindex: Index of multiple instances of specified Variable.
            parameter_index: Index of metaparameter within Variable to update.
            vector_location: Index of scalar metaparameter within flattened array of array-type parameter.
            value: Value with which to update metaparameter.

        Returns:
            - bool - The parameter has been set
            - bool - The deterministic value of the Variable has been impacted
            - bool - The DSA value(s) of the Variable has/have been impacted
            - bool - The PSA values(s) of the Variable has/have been impacted
            - tuple[Param, ...] - The set of parameters now held by the Variable
        """
        varid = make_varid(key = key, section = section, subindex = subindex)
        var = self.variables.get(varid)
        if var is None:
            raise ValueError(f'variable {varid} not found')
        return update_variable(var, parameter_index, vector_location, value)

    def update_model_from_variable_deterministic(
        self,
        section: str,
        key: str | None = None,
        subindex: int | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Update the attached model with the deterministic value of the addressed variable

        Variable address is {section}.{key}.{subindex} in the .variables OrderedDict
        """
        if key is None and subindex is None:
            varid = section
        else:
            if key is None:
                key = ''
            if subindex is None:
                subindex = 0
            varid = make_varid(key = key, section = section, subindex = subindex)

        var = self.variables.get(varid)
        if var is None:
            raise ValueError(f'variable {varid} not found')
        if var.configuration_type == 'finance':
            var.update_model(self.finance)
        else:
            var.update_model(self.model)
        self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision
        return var.configuration_type

    def sync_model_with_changed_variables_deterministic(
        self
    ) -> set[str]:
        """Update the NewSEGS Energy Model and finance model with the deterministic values of any variables that have changed.

        Variables are compared by revision with the last synchronisation. The results tables of the models affected are invalidated.

        Returns:
            The types of model (`model`, `finance`) that were affected.
        """
        affected_models = set()
        for varid, var in self.variables.items():
            if self._variables_last_model_sync.get(varid, -1) != var.revision:
                try:
                    if isinstance(varid, str):
                        affected_models.add(self.update_model_from_variable_deterministic(varid)) 
                except ValueError as e:
                    logger.error(e)

                self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision

        # Invalidate results
        if 'model' in affected_models:
            self.model.table_config._notify_change()
            self.finance.table_config._notify_change()
        elif 'finance' in affected_models:
            self.finance.table_config._notify_change()

        return affected_models

    def _prepare_object_state(self):
        super()._prepare_object_state()
        self._variable_ids = self.variable_ids

    @override
    def _preupdate_from_dict(self, config):
        super()._preupdate_from_dict(config)
        # Set the watcher prior to property attachment
        if not hasattr(self, '_watcher') or self._watcher is None:
            self.watcher = MMVarWatcher(self)

        if 'model' in config:
            self.model = config.pop('model')
        if 'finance' in config:
            self.finance = config.pop('finance')
            try:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model)
            except AttributeError:
                pass

    @override
    def _post_update_from_dict(self):
        # A representation of the metamodel (`to_dict_repr`, as in a configuration file) holds its variables, which
        # the update sets directly, leaving them a plain dict. They are set again through the `variables` property, so
        # that they are held in an observable dictionary to which the table configuration and the watcher subscribe,
        # as when they are reattached from the database. (Only `update` reaches here: `__setstate__`, used to copy and
        # unpickle, restores the observable dictionary itself.)
        variables = self.__dict__.get('_variables')
        if variables is not None and not isinstance(variables, TableModifyingObservableOrderedDict):
            del self.__dict__['_variables']
            self.variables = dict(variables)
        try:
            if self.finance.model is None or self.finance.model is not self.model:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model, dirty = False)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        super()._post_update_from_dict()

    @override
    def anonymise_ids(self, include_variables = False):
        if include_variables:
            return super().anonymise_ids()
        else:
            SerialisedConfigurationMixin.anonymise_ids(self)
            self._anonymise_id_sequence(self.get_components(component_group = 'exclude_variables'))

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        cls = self.__class__
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        memo[id(self)] = result

        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded')
        state = self.__getstate__()
        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded_and_components')

        state = {k:copy.deepcopy(v, memo) for k, v in state.items() if k != '_variables'}

        result.__setstate__(state)

        # Need to generate a new container, but the contents must be identical
        result.variables = {k: v for k, v in self.variables.items()}
        result.variables.revision = self.variables.revision # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]

        result.revision = self.revision
        result.table_config.revision = self.table_config.revision
        return result

    def to_config(self) -> dict[str, str|int|float]:
        """
        Simplify metamodel to a simple dictionary for passing around.
        """
        return {
            'name': self.name,
            'metamodel_id': self.id,
            '_model_id': self.model_id,
            '_finance_id': self.finance_id,
            'last_modified': self._last_modified.isoformat()
        }

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `generate_new_config` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    @classmethod
    def generate_new_config(cls) -> dict[str, str|int|float]:
        """
        Generate a configuration using random ids for self, model and finance.
        """
        return {
            'name': cls._name,
            'metamodel_id': cls.generate_new_id(),
            '_model_id': NewsegsModelInterface.generate_new_id(),
            '_finance_id': NewsegsFinanceInterface.generate_new_id(),
            'last_modified': datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        }

    def reattach_model(
    self,
    model_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsModelInterface]
) -> None:
    """Reattach the associated NewsegsModel instance after metamodel reconstruction.

    Args:
        model_provider: Mapping of model IDs to NewsegsModel instances.

    Raises:
        AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated model ID.
        ValueError: If model_provider cannot provide the model.
        TypeError: If the provided object is not a NewsegsModel.
    """
    if not hasattr(self, '_model_id') or self._model_id == '':
        raise AttributeError('this MetaModel has no associated model to reattach.')
    mdl = model_provider.get(self._model_id)
    if mdl is None:
        raise ValueError(f'model_provider could not provide model for key {self._model_id}')
    if not isinstance(mdl, NewsegsModelInterface):
        raise TypeError(f'model_provider did not provide a NewsegsModel for key {self._model_id} - {type(mdl)} returned instead')
    self.model = mdl
    try:
        if self.finance is not None:
            self.finance.set_model(self.model)
    except AttributeError:
        pass

    def reattach_variables(self, variable_provider: VariableProviderInterface) -> None:
    """Reattach any associated Variables after metamodel reconstruction.

    Args:
        variable_provider: Instance of VariableProviderInterface (typically a Project).
    """
    these_vars = self.variable_ids
    r0 = self.revision
    tr0 = self.table_config.revision
    vr0 = self.variables.revision # type: ignore
    for var_identifiers in these_vars:
        try:
            v = variable_provider.get_variable(var_identifiers['uid'])
        except KeyError:
            v = variable_provider.get_default_variable(var_identifiers['varid'])
        self.variables[var_identifiers['varid']] = v
    self.variables.revision = vr0 # type: ignore
    self.revision = r0
    self.table_config.revision = tr0

    def sync_model_with_changed_variables_deterministic(
    self
) -> set[str]:
    """Update the NewSEGS Energy Model and finance model with the deterministic values of any variables that have changed.

    Variables are compared by revision with the last synchronisation. The results tables of the models affected are invalidated.

    Returns:
        The types of model (`model`, `finance`) that were affected.
    """
    affected_models = set()
    for varid, var in self.variables.items():
        if self._variables_last_model_sync.get(varid, -1) != var.revision:
            try:
                if isinstance(varid, str):
                    affected_models.add(self.update_model_from_variable_deterministic(varid)) 
            except ValueError as e:
                logger.error(e)

            self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision

    # Invalidate results

        self.model.table_config._notify_change()
        self.finance.table_config._notify_change()
    elif 'finance' in affected_models:
        self.finance.table_config._notify_change()

    return affected_models

    class MMVarWatcher(RevisionNotifierProtocol):
    """Watches the variables of a metamodel.

    Notified when the variables of the metamodel change, so that the metamodel can keep a record of
    which variables have been synchronised with its NewSEGS Energy Model and finance model.
    """
    def __init__(self, metamodel: 'NewsegsMetaModel'):
        self._metamodel = metamodel
        self._held_ids = {}

    def update_held_ids(self):
        """Update the record of the variables of the metamodel.

        Variables which have been removed are forgotten, and new variables are marked as needing to be synchronised with the models.
        """
        mm = self._metamodel
        previous_varids = set(self._held_ids.keys())
        extant_varids = set(mm.variables.keys())

        new_varids = extant_varids - previous_varids
        removed_varids = previous_varids - extant_varids
        continuing_varids = extant_varids & previous_varids

        changed_varids = set(self._held_ids[x] != mm.variables[x].id for x in continuing_varids)

        for varid in removed_varids:
            if varid in mm._variables_last_model_sync:
                del mm._variables_last_model_sync[varid]

        for varid in new_varids:
            # Set to require sync
            mm._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = -1

        for varid in changed_varids:
            # Set to require sync
            mm._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = -1 

        self._held_ids = {x: mm.variables[x].id for x in extant_varids}

    def _add_child(self, child: 'RevisionNotifierProtocol', subscribe: bool = True): 
        # Only need to receive notifications of change, don't need to check on revision status
        if subscribe and isinstance(child, SubscriptionRevisionNotifierMixin):
            child._subscribers.append(self)

    def _remove_child(self, child: 'RevisionNotifierProtocol'):
        if isinstance(child, SubscriptionRevisionNotifierMixin):
            child.unsubscribe(self)

    def _notify_change(self, trigger: Any | None = None, **kwargs):
        if isinstance(trigger, (TableModifyingObservableOrderedDict)):
            self.update_held_ids()

    def update_held_ids(self):
    """Update the record of the variables of the metamodel.

    Variables which have been removed are forgotten, and new variables are marked as needing to be synchronised with the models.
    """
    mm = self._metamodel
    previous_varids = set(self._held_ids.keys())
    extant_varids = set(mm.variables.keys())

    new_varids = extant_varids - previous_varids
    removed_varids = previous_varids - extant_varids
    continuing_varids = extant_varids & previous_varids

    changed_varids = set(self._held_ids[x] != mm.variables[x].id for x in continuing_varids)

    for varid in removed_varids:
        if varid in mm._variables_last_model_sync:
            del mm._variables_last_model_sync[varid]

    for varid in new_varids:
        # Set to require sync
        mm._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = -1

    for varid in changed_varids:
        # Set to require sync
        mm._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = -1 

    self._held_ids = {x: mm.variables[x].id for x in extant_varids}

    NewsegsMetaModel ¶

    Bases: TableOwningNewsegsComponent

    A container and controller for models and variables.

    Principally, a NewsegsMetaModel holds:

    • A reference to a NewsegsModel
    • A reference to a NewsegsFinance which itself references the NewsegsModel
    • A series of Variables which locate the values in the NewsegsModel and NewsegsFinance
    • An OptimComponent holding the method and statistic of optimisation

    The metamodel can be set into a state:

    • Deterministic run
    • Deterministic probability analysis
    • Probabilistic sensitivity analysis

    Its state is used to control the behaviour of its Variables and to propagate live values into its NewsegsModel and NewsegsFinance. These models can then be run and values extracted.

    For a dsa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond to a change in a single Variable.

    For a psa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond to a sample across all enabled PSA variables.

    class NewsegsMetaModel(TableOwningNewsegsComponent):
    """A container and controller for models and variables.

    Principally, a NewsegsMetaModel holds:

    - A reference to a NewsegsModel
    - A reference to a NewsegsFinance which itself references the NewsegsModel
    - A series of Variables which locate the values in the NewsegsModel and
      NewsegsFinance
    - An OptimComponent holding the method and statistic of optimisation

    The metamodel can be set into a state:

    - Deterministic run
    - Deterministic probability analysis
    - Probabilistic sensitivity analysis

    Its state is used to control the behaviour of its Variables and to propagate
    live values into its NewsegsModel and NewsegsFinance. These models can then be
    run and values extracted.

    For a dsa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a
    dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond
    to a change in a single Variable.

    For a psa run, a (small) number of statistics must be nominated to be held in a
    dataframe which will be accessible after completion; each row will correspond
    to a sample across all enabled PSA variables.
    """

    model_id: str
    finance_id: str
    checked_out: bool = False

    _name = 'Configuration'
    _version = '0.1.0'
    _id_prefix = COMPONENT_PREFIXES['metamodel']
    _last_modified: datetime.datetime = datetime.datetime.now()

    _excluded_attributes = NewsegsComponent._excluded_attributes.union({'_watcher'})

    last_dsa_run: float = 0.
    last_psa_run: float = 0.
    last_optim_run: float = 0.

    model = ComponentProperty(default = None, oftype = NewsegsModelInterface)
    finance = ComponentProperty(default = None, oftype = NewsegsFinanceInterface)
    optim_config = ComponentProperty(default = OptimComponent, oftype = OptimComponent)
    """The optimisation settings; a metamodel saved without them is given the defaults."""

    variables = TableModifyingComponentOrderedDictProperty(oftype = variable.Variable)
    _variables_last_model_sync: dict
    """The revision number of the variable at last deterministic sync."""

    @override
    def _generate_config(self, *args, **kwargs) -> NewsegsMetaModelConfig:
        return NewsegsMetaModelConfig(*args, **kwargs)
    _config: NewsegsMetaModelConfig # pyright: ignore[reportIncompatibleVariableOverride]

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: NewsegsModelInterface,
        finance: NewsegsFinanceInterface,
        variables: MutableSequence[variable.Variable] = [],
        table_config: Optional[TableConfigNewsegsComponent] = None,
        optim_config: Optional[OptimComponent] = None,
        **kwargs
    ):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)

        self.table_config = table_config or TableConfigNewsegsComponent()
        self.optim_config = optim_config or OptimComponent()
        self.watcher = MMVarWatcher(self)

        self.model = model
        self.finance = finance

        self.variables = {variable.variable_uid(x):x for x in variables}
        self._variables_last_model_sync = {}

    @property
    def watcher(self) -> RevisionNotifierProtocol:
        """The watcher which tracks changes to the variables; created on first use.
        """
        if self._watcher is None:
            self._watcher = MMVarWatcher(self)
        return self._watcher

    @watcher.setter
    def watcher(self, watcher: RevisionNotifierProtocol):
        self._watcher = watcher

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `reattach_model` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def reattach_model(
        self,
        model_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsModelInterface]
    ) -> None:
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsModel instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            model_provider: Mapping of model IDs to NewsegsModel instances.

        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated model ID.
            ValueError: If model_provider cannot provide the model.
            TypeError: If the provided object is not a NewsegsModel.
        """
        if not hasattr(self, '_model_id') or self._model_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('this MetaModel has no associated model to reattach.')
        mdl = model_provider.get(self._model_id)
        if mdl is None:
            raise ValueError(f'model_provider could not provide model for key {self._model_id}')
        if not isinstance(mdl, NewsegsModelInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'model_provider did not provide a NewsegsModel for key {self._model_id} - {type(mdl)} returned instead')
        self.model = mdl
        try:
            if self.finance is not None:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model)
        except AttributeError:
            pass

    def reattach_em(self, em_provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsModel instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        """
        r0 = self.revision
        if not hasattr(self, '_model_id') or self._model_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('This MetaModel has no associated model to reattach.')
        mdl = em_provider.get_component(self._model_id)
        if not isinstance(mdl, NewsegsModelInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'em_provider did not provide a NewsegsModel for key {self._model_id}')
        self.model = mdl
        try:
            if self.finance is not None:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        self.revision = r0

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `reattach_finance` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def reattach_finance(self, finance_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsFinanceInterface]) -> None:
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsFinance instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            finance_provider: Mapping of finance IDs to NewsegsFinance instances.

        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated finance ID.
            ValueError: If finance_provider cannot provide the finance.
            TypeError: If the provided object is not a NewsegsFinance.
        """
        r0 = self.revision
        if not hasattr(self, '_finance_id') or self._finance_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('this MetaModel has no associated finance to reattach.')
        fnc = finance_provider.get(self._finance_id)
        if fnc is None:
            raise ValueError(f'finance_provider could not provide finance for key {self._finance_id}')
        if not isinstance(fnc, NewsegsFinanceInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'finance_provider did not provide a NewsegsFinance for key {self._finance_id} - {type(fnc)} returned instead')
        self.finance = fnc
        if self.model is not None:
            self.finance.set_model(self.model, dirty = False)
        self.revision = r0

    def reattach_fm(self, fm_provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
        """Reattach the associated NewsegsFinance instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        """
        r0 = self.revision
        if not hasattr(self, '_finance_id') or self._finance_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('This MetaModel has no associated finance to reattach.')
        fnc = fm_provider.get_component(self._finance_id)
        if not isinstance(fnc, NewsegsFinanceInterface):
            raise TypeError(f'fm_provider did not provide a NewsegsFinance for key {self._finance_id}')
        self.finance = fnc
        try:
            if self.model is not None:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model, False)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        self.revision = r0

    # def get_component_attributes(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    #     atts = super().get_component_attributes()
    #     return ('table_config', *atts)

    @property
    def variable_ids(self) -> tuple[dict[str, str], ...]:
        # As variables cannot exist until table_config has been reattached,
        # only search for _variable_ids during child uid update
        """The varid and the id of each variable of the metamodel.
        """
        if self.table_config is None:
            return getattr(self, '_variable_ids', ())
        if len(self.variables) == 0 and hasattr(self, '_variable_ids'):
            return self._variable_ids
        return tuple(
            {
                'varid': k,
                'uid': x.id
            } for k, x in self.variables.items()
        )

    def reattach_variables(self, variable_provider: VariableProviderInterface) -> None:
        """Reattach any associated Variables after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            variable_provider: Instance of VariableProviderInterface (typically a Project).
        """
        these_vars = self.variable_ids
        r0 = self.revision
        tr0 = self.table_config.revision
        vr0 = self.variables.revision # type: ignore
        for var_identifiers in these_vars:
            try:
                v = variable_provider.get_variable(var_identifiers['uid'])
            except KeyError:
                v = variable_provider.get_default_variable(var_identifiers['varid'])
            self.variables[var_identifiers['varid']] = v
        self.variables.revision = vr0 # type: ignore
        self.revision = r0
        self.table_config.revision = tr0


    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `reattach_table_config` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def reattach_table_config(self, component_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsComponent]):
        """Reattach the associated TableConfig instance after metamodel reconstruction.

        Args:
            component_provider: Mapping of component IDs to NewsegsComponent instances.
        Raises:
            AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated table config ID.
            ValueError: If component_provider cannot provide the table config.
            TypeError: If the provided object is not a TableConfigNewsegsComponent.
        """
        if not hasattr(self, '_table_config_id') or self._table_config_id == '':
            raise AttributeError('This MetaModel has no associated TableConfig to reattach.')
        tc = component_provider.get(self._table_config_id)
        if tc is None:
            raise ValueError(f'component_provider could not provide table config for key {self._table_config_id}')
        if not isinstance(tc, TableConfigNewsegsComponent):
            raise TypeError(f'component_provider did not provide a TableConfigNewsegsComponent for key {self._table_config_id}')
        self.table_config = tc

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `update_variable_from_interface` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def update_variable_from_interface(
        self,
        section: str,
        key: str,
        subindex: int,
        parameter_index: int,
        vector_location: int,
        value: variable.ScalarParam
    ) -> tuple[bool, bool, bool, bool, tuple[variable.Param,...]]:
        """
        Update the addressed variable with the new value.

        The Variable is addressed by {section}.{key}.{subindex} in the 
        .variables OrderedDict. After identifying the variable, the nominated 
        parameter index is updated with the scalar value; if the parameter is
        an array type, it is addressed by its location in the flattened array
        using the vector_location.

        Args:
            section: Interface section.
            key: Variable specifier.
            subindex: Index of multiple instances of specified Variable.
            parameter_index: Index of metaparameter within Variable to update.
            vector_location: Index of scalar metaparameter within flattened array of array-type parameter.
            value: Value with which to update metaparameter.

        Returns:
            - bool - The parameter has been set
            - bool - The deterministic value of the Variable has been impacted
            - bool - The DSA value(s) of the Variable has/have been impacted
            - bool - The PSA values(s) of the Variable has/have been impacted
            - tuple[Param, ...] - The set of parameters now held by the Variable
        """
        varid = make_varid(key = key, section = section, subindex = subindex)
        var = self.variables.get(varid)
        if var is None:
            raise ValueError(f'variable {varid} not found')
        return update_variable(var, parameter_index, vector_location, value)

    def update_model_from_variable_deterministic(
        self,
        section: str,
        key: str | None = None,
        subindex: int | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """
        Update the attached model with the deterministic value of the addressed variable

        Variable address is {section}.{key}.{subindex} in the .variables OrderedDict
        """
        if key is None and subindex is None:
            varid = section
        else:
            if key is None:
                key = ''
            if subindex is None:
                subindex = 0
            varid = make_varid(key = key, section = section, subindex = subindex)

        var = self.variables.get(varid)
        if var is None:
            raise ValueError(f'variable {varid} not found')
        if var.configuration_type == 'finance':
            var.update_model(self.finance)
        else:
            var.update_model(self.model)
        self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision
        return var.configuration_type

    def sync_model_with_changed_variables_deterministic(
        self
    ) -> set[str]:
        """Update the NewSEGS Energy Model and finance model with the deterministic values of any variables that have changed.

        Variables are compared by revision with the last synchronisation. The results tables of the models affected are invalidated.

        Returns:
            The types of model (`model`, `finance`) that were affected.
        """
        affected_models = set()
        for varid, var in self.variables.items():
            if self._variables_last_model_sync.get(varid, -1) != var.revision:
                try:
                    if isinstance(varid, str):
                        affected_models.add(self.update_model_from_variable_deterministic(varid)) 
                except ValueError as e:
                    logger.error(e)

                self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision

        # Invalidate results
        if 'model' in affected_models:
            self.model.table_config._notify_change()
            self.finance.table_config._notify_change()
        elif 'finance' in affected_models:
            self.finance.table_config._notify_change()

        return affected_models

    @override
    def _prepare_object_state(self):
        super()._prepare_object_state()
        self._variable_ids = self.variable_ids

    @override
    def _preupdate_from_dict(self, config):
        super()._preupdate_from_dict(config)
        # Set the watcher prior to property attachment
        if not hasattr(self, '_watcher') or self._watcher is None:
            self.watcher = MMVarWatcher(self)

        if 'model' in config:
            self.model = config.pop('model')
        if 'finance' in config:
            self.finance = config.pop('finance')
            try:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model)
            except AttributeError:
                pass

    @override
    def _post_update_from_dict(self):
        # A representation of the metamodel (`to_dict_repr`, as in a configuration file) holds its variables, which
        # the update sets directly, leaving them a plain dict. They are set again through the `variables` property, so
        # that they are held in an observable dictionary to which the table configuration and the watcher subscribe,
        # as when they are reattached from the database. (Only `update` reaches here: `__setstate__`, used to copy and
        # unpickle, restores the observable dictionary itself.)
        variables = self.__dict__.get('_variables')
        if variables is not None and not isinstance(variables, TableModifyingObservableOrderedDict):
            del self.__dict__['_variables']
            self.variables = dict(variables)
        try:
            if self.finance.model is None or self.finance.model is not self.model:
                self.finance.set_model(self.model, dirty = False)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
        super()._post_update_from_dict()

    @override
    def anonymise_ids(self, include_variables = False):
        if include_variables:
            return super().anonymise_ids()
        else:
            SerialisedConfigurationMixin.anonymise_ids(self)
            self._anonymise_id_sequence(self.get_components(component_group = 'exclude_variables'))

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        cls = self.__class__
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        memo[id(self)] = result

        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded')
        state = self.__getstate__()
        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded_and_components')

        state = {k:copy.deepcopy(v, memo) for k, v in state.items() if k != '_variables'}

        result.__setstate__(state)

        # Need to generate a new container, but the contents must be identical
        result.variables = {k: v for k, v in self.variables.items()}
        result.variables.revision = self.variables.revision # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]

        result.revision = self.revision
        result.table_config.revision = self.table_config.revision
        return result

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `to_config` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def to_config(self) -> dict[str, str|int|float]:
        """
        Simplify metamodel to a simple dictionary for passing around.
        """
        return {
            'name': self.name,
            'metamodel_id': self.id,
            '_model_id': self.model_id,
            '_finance_id': self.finance_id,
            'last_modified': self._last_modified.isoformat()
        }

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `generate_new_config` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    @classmethod
    def generate_new_config(cls) -> dict[str, str|int|float]:
        """
        Generate a configuration using random ids for self, model and finance.
        """
        return {
            'name': cls._name,
            'metamodel_id': cls.generate_new_id(),
            '_model_id': NewsegsModelInterface.generate_new_id(),
            '_finance_id': NewsegsFinanceInterface.generate_new_id(),
            'last_modified': datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
        }

    def reattach_model(
    self,
    model_provider: Mapping[str, NewsegsModelInterface]
) -> None:
    """Reattach the associated NewsegsModel instance after metamodel reconstruction.

    Args:
        model_provider: Mapping of model IDs to NewsegsModel instances.

    Raises:
        AttributeError: If the MetaModel has no associated model ID.
        ValueError: If model_provider cannot provide the model.
        TypeError: If the provided object is not a NewsegsModel.
    """
    if not hasattr(self, '_model_id') or self._model_id == '':
        raise AttributeError('this MetaModel has no associated model to reattach.')
    mdl = model_provider.get(self._model_id)
    if mdl is None:
        raise ValueError(f'model_provider could not provide model for key {self._model_id}')
    if not isinstance(mdl, NewsegsModelInterface):
        raise TypeError(f'model_provider did not provide a NewsegsModel for key {self._model_id} - {type(mdl)} returned instead')
    self.model = mdl
    try:
        if self.finance is not None:
            self.finance.set_model(self.model)
    except AttributeError:
        pass

    def reattach_variables(self, variable_provider: VariableProviderInterface) -> None:
    """Reattach any associated Variables after metamodel reconstruction.

    Args:
        variable_provider: Instance of VariableProviderInterface (typically a Project).
    """
    these_vars = self.variable_ids
    r0 = self.revision
    tr0 = self.table_config.revision
    vr0 = self.variables.revision # type: ignore
    for var_identifiers in these_vars:
        try:
            v = variable_provider.get_variable(var_identifiers['uid'])
        except KeyError:
            v = variable_provider.get_default_variable(var_identifiers['varid'])
        self.variables[var_identifiers['varid']] = v
    self.variables.revision = vr0 # type: ignore
    self.revision = r0
    self.table_config.revision = tr0

    def update_variable_from_interface(
    self,
    section: str,
    key: str,
    subindex: int,
    parameter_index: int,
    vector_location: int,
    value: variable.ScalarParam
) -> tuple[bool, bool, bool, bool, tuple[variable.Param,...]]:
    """
    Update the addressed variable with the new value.

    The Variable is addressed by {section}.{key}.{subindex} in the 
    .variables OrderedDict. After identifying the variable, the nominated 
    parameter index is updated with the scalar value; if the parameter is
    an array type, it is addressed by its location in the flattened array
    using the vector_location.

    Args:
        section: Interface section.
        key: Variable specifier.
        subindex: Index of multiple instances of specified Variable.
        parameter_index: Index of metaparameter within Variable to update.
        vector_location: Index of scalar metaparameter within flattened array of array-type parameter.
        value: Value with which to update metaparameter.

    Returns:
        - bool - The parameter has been set
        - bool - The deterministic value of the Variable has been impacted
        - bool - The DSA value(s) of the Variable has/have been impacted
        - bool - The PSA values(s) of the Variable has/have been impacted
        - tuple[Param, ...] - The set of parameters now held by the Variable
    """
    varid = make_varid(key = key, section = section, subindex = subindex)
    var = self.variables.get(varid)
    if var is None:
        raise ValueError(f'variable {varid} not found')
    return update_variable(var, parameter_index, vector_location, value)

    def update_model_from_variable_deterministic(
    self,
    section: str,
    key: str | None = None,
    subindex: int | None = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Update the attached model with the deterministic value of the addressed variable

    Variable address is {section}.{key}.{subindex} in the .variables OrderedDict
    """
    if key is None and subindex is None:
        varid = section
    else:
        if key is None:
            key = ''
        if subindex is None:
            subindex = 0
        varid = make_varid(key = key, section = section, subindex = subindex)

    var = self.variables.get(varid)
    if var is None:
        raise ValueError(f'variable {varid} not found')
    if var.configuration_type == 'finance':
        var.update_model(self.finance)
    else:
        var.update_model(self.model)
    self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision
    return var.configuration_type

    def sync_model_with_changed_variables_deterministic(
    self
) -> set[str]:
    """Update the NewSEGS Energy Model and finance model with the deterministic values of any variables that have changed.

    Variables are compared by revision with the last synchronisation. The results tables of the models affected are invalidated.

    Returns:
        The types of model (`model`, `finance`) that were affected.
    """
    affected_models = set()
    for varid, var in self.variables.items():
        if self._variables_last_model_sync.get(varid, -1) != var.revision:
            try:
                if isinstance(varid, str):
                    affected_models.add(self.update_model_from_variable_deterministic(varid)) 
            except ValueError as e:
                logger.error(e)

            self._variables_last_model_sync[varid] = var.revision

    # Invalidate results
    if 'model' in affected_models:
        self.model.table_config._notify_change()
        self.finance.table_config._notify_change()
    elif 'finance' in affected_models:
        self.finance.table_config._notify_change()

    return affected_models

    @revision_dataclass
class OptimComponentConfig(DataWithRevision):
    """Configuration of the optimisation of a metamodel.

    Attributes:
        method: The scipy optimisation method; one of `OPTIMISATION_METHODS`.
        statistic: The statistic to maximise; one of `OPTIM_TARGET_STATISTICS`.

    Project¶

    A project holds one or more metamodels together with the default variables, and the sensitivity analysis configuration, that apply to them. See Framework plugins for how projects are created.

    NewsegsMetaModel¶

    A NewsegsMetaModel is a NewsegsComponent which acts as a container for a NewsegsModel, an associated NewsegsFinance, and a collection of Variables which correspond to parameters within the Model and Finance components.

    Unlike its contained values, the NewsegsMetaModel class is not abstract, but serves as a concrete implementation of its purpose.

    When serialising to dict, its associated Model and Finance are excluded; when unserialising, these objects must be reattached by providing the Metamodel with a mapping that can return the appropriate Model or Finance instance when provided with its id.

    class NewsegsProject(TableOwningNewsegsComponent, RecoverableInMemoryVariableProvider):
    """A container and controller for metamodels and variables."""

    _name = 'Untitled project'
    _version = 'v0.0.1'
    _id_prefix = COMPONENT_PREFIXES['project']

    _excluded_attributes = NewsegsComponent._excluded_attributes.union(
        {'_watcher', '_variables_by_uid', '_variables_by_varid'}
    )

    metamodels = TableModifyingComponentListProperty(oftype = newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel)
    dsa_config = ComponentProperty(default = DSAComponent, oftype = DSAComponent)
    psa_config = ComponentProperty(default = PSAComponent, oftype = PSAComponent)

    _focussed_metamodel: int = 0
    _watcher: RevisionNotifierProtocol | None = None

    @override
    def _generate_config(self, *args, **kwargs) -> NewsegsProjectConfig:
        return NewsegsProjectConfig(*args, **kwargs)
    _config: NewsegsProjectConfig # pyright: ignore[reportIncompatibleVariableOverride]

    def __init__(
        self,
        metamodels: Optional[Sequence[newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel]] = [],
        *args,
        default_variables: Optional[Sequence[Variable]] = [],
        dsa_config: Optional[DSAComponent] = None,
        psa_config: Optional[PSAComponent] = None,
        table_config: Optional[TableConfigNewsegsComponent] = None,
        **kwargs
    ):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        InMemoryVariableProvider.__init__(self, default_variables)

        self.table_config = table_config or TableConfigNewsegsComponent()
        self.watcher = ProjVarWatcher(self)
        self.dsa_config = dsa_config or DSAComponent()
        self.psa_config = psa_config or PSAComponent()

        self.metamodels = metamodels or []
        if len(self.metamodels):
            if not self.model_type == self.metamodels[0].model.model_type:
                if self.model_type == '':
                    self.model_type = self.metamodels[0].model.model_type
                else:
                    raise TypeError(f'First metamodel of incompatible type; Expected: {self.model_type}; received: {self.metamodels[0].model.model_type}')
            if not self.model_version == self.metamodels[0].model.version:
                if self.model_version == '':
                    self.model_version = self.metamodels[0].model.version
                else:
                    raise TypeError(f'First metamodel of incompatible version; Expected: {self.model_version}; received: {self.metamodels[0].model.version}')

    @property
    def metamodel_ids(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """The ids of the metamodels, in order.
        """
        return tuple(mm.id for mm in self.metamodels)

    @property
    def watcher(self) -> RevisionNotifierProtocol:
        """The watcher which tracks changes to the metamodels; created on first use.
        """
        if self._watcher is None:
            self._watcher = ProjVarWatcher(self)
        return self._watcher

    @watcher.setter
    def watcher(self, watcher: RevisionNotifierProtocol):
        self._watcher = watcher

    def get_focussed_metamodel_index(self) -> int:
        """The index of the focussed metamodel.

        The focussed metamodel is the one displayed and run by the app. Raises `ValueError` if the project has no metamodels.

        Returns:
            The index.
        """
        if self._focussed_metamodel >= len(self.metamodels):
            if len(self.metamodels) == 0:
                raise ValueError('No metamodels within project')
            else:
                self._focussed_metamodel = len(self.metamodels) - 1
        return self._focussed_metamodel

    def set_focussed_metamodel_index(self, metamodel_index: int = 0):
        """Set the focussed metamodel by index.

        Args:
            metamodel_index: Index of the metamodel within the project.
        """
        self.set_focussed_metamodel(metamodel_index = metamodel_index)

    def get_focussed_metamodel(self):
        """The focussed metamodel.

        Returns:
            The metamodel.
        """
        return self.metamodels[self.get_focussed_metamodel_index()]

    def set_focussed_metamodel(self, metamodel_id: Optional[str] = None, metamodel_index: int = 0):
        """Set the focussed metamodel by id or by index.

        The id is used if given and found; otherwise the index, limited to the metamodels available.

        Args:
            metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.
            metamodel_index: Index of the metamodel within the project.
        """
        if metamodel_id:
            for i, mm in enumerate(self.metamodels):
                if mm.id == metamodel_id:
                    self._focussed_metamodel = i
                    return
        self._focussed_metamodel = max(0, min(len(self.metamodels)-1, metamodel_index))

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `duplicate_metamodel` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def duplicate_metamodel(self, metamodel_id: str) -> newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel:
        """Add a copy of a metamodel, with new ids, to the project.

        Raises `ValueError` if the metamodel is not found.

        Args:
            metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.

        Returns:
            The copy.
        """
        try:
            wch = self.metamodel_ids.index(metamodel_id)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError(f'Metamodel not found: {metamodel_id}')
        mm = self.metamodels[wch]

        mm2 = copy.deepcopy(mm)
        mm2.anonymise_ids()

        self.metamodels.append(mm2) # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType, reportAttributeAccessIssue]
        return mm2 # pyright: ignore[reportReturnType]

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        cls = self.__class__
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        memo[id(self)] = result

        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded')
        state = self.__getstate__()
        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded_and_components')

        state = {k:copy.deepcopy(v, memo) for k, v in state.items()}

        result.__setstate__(state)

        # Reattach the metamodel variables from self, then add them to result,
        # then duplicate and reattach
        for mm in result.metamodels:
            mm.reattach_variables(self)

        #for var in mm.variables.values():
        #    self.add_variable(var)

        new_vars = []
        for varid, varlist in self._variables_by_varid.items():
            for uid, var in varlist.items():
                old_id = var.id
                new_var = copy.deepcopy(var)
                new_var.anonymise_ids()
                new_vars.append(new_var)
                for mm in result.metamodels:
                    if mm.variables[varid].id == old_id:
                        mm.variables[varid] = new_var
        result._variables_by_varid.clear()
        result._variables_by_uid.clear()
        for var in new_vars:
            result.add_variable(var)

        result.revision = self.revision
        result.table_config.revision = self.table_config.revision

        # Other id anonymisation should take place outside of the copy

        return result

    def reattach_metamodels(self, provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
        """Reattach the metamodels of a project after it has been reconstructed.

        The metamodels are found from the ids recorded when the project was serialised, and given the variables of the project. The revisions are preserved.

        Args:
            provider: Provider from which to recover the components.
        """
        if not hasattr(self, '_metamodel_ids') or not self._metamodel_ids:
            return
        r0 = self.revision
        tr0 = self.table_config.revision
        metamodels = provider.get_component(self._metamodel_ids)
        for i, mm in enumerate(metamodels):
            if not isinstance(mm, newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel):
                raise TypeError(f'Component provider did not return a metamodel for id {self._metamodel_ids[i]}, is {type(mm)}')
            mm.reattach_variables(self)
        self.metamodels = metamodels
        self.revision = r0
        self.table_config.revision = tr0

    def get_metamodel_by_id(self, metamodel_id: str):
        """Get a metamodel by id.

        Raises `KeyError` if it is not found.

        Args:
            metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.

        Returns:
            The metamodel.
        """
        for mm in self.metamodels:
            if mm.id == metamodel_id:
                break
        else:
            raise KeyError(f'Metamodel {metamodel_id} not found for project {self.name}[{self.id}] - available values are {[x.id for x in self.metamodels]}.')
        return mm

    @override
    def _prepare_object_state(self):
        super()._prepare_object_state()
        self._metamodel_ids = self.metamodel_ids
        vrus = dict()
        for k, v in self._variables_by_varid.items():
            vrus[k] = list(v.keys())

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `variable_to_store` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def variable_to_store(
        self, 
        store_interface: VariablePersistenceInterface, 
        variable_id: Optional['str | SequenceNotStr[str]'] = None,
        force: bool = False,
    ):
        """Write variables of the project to a store.

        Args:
            store_interface: The store to which the variables are written.
            variable_id: Id(s) of the variable(s); all variables if None.
            force: Write the variables even if their revisions have not changed.
        """
        if isinstance(variable_id, str):
            variable_id = [variable_id, ]
        elif variable_id is None:
            variable_id = list(self._variables_by_uid.keys())

        vars = [self.get_variable(x) for x in variable_id]
        store_interface.upsert_variable(vars, force)

    @override
    def _preupdate_from_dict(self, config):
        super()._preupdate_from_dict(config)
        if not hasattr(self, '_variables_by_varid'):
            self._variables_by_varid = OrderedDict()
        if not hasattr(self, '_variables_by_uid'):
            self._variables_by_uid = dict()

    elif variable_id is None:
        variable_id = list(self._variables_by_uid.keys())

    vars = [self.get_variable(x) for x in variable_id]
    store_interface.upsert_variable(vars, force)

    class ProjVarWatcher(RevisionNotifierProtocol):

    """Watches the metamodels of a project, so that the project holds the variables of every metamodel when metamodels are added or removed.
    """
    def __init__(self, project: 'NewsegsProject'):
        self._project = project

    def _add_child(self, child: 'RevisionNotifierProtocol', subscribe: bool = True): 
        # Only need to receive notifications of change, don't need to check on revision status
        if subscribe and isinstance(child, SubscriptionRevisionNotifierMixin):
            child._subscribers.append(self)

    def _remove_child(self, child: 'RevisionNotifierProtocol'):
        if isinstance(child, SubscriptionRevisionNotifierMixin):
            child.unsubscribe(self)

    def _notify_change(self, trigger: Any | None = None, **kwargs):
        if isinstance(trigger, (TableModifyingObservableList, TableModifyingObservableOrderedDict)):
            proj = self._project
            # Something has happened to the metamodels table, check we have all variables
            var_uids = set(proj._variables_by_uid.keys())
            found_uids = set()
            for mm in proj.metamodels:
                for var in mm.variables.values():
                    vid = var.id
                    if not vid in var_uids:
                        added_uid = proj.add_variable(var)
                        if not vid == added_uid:
                            warnings.warn(f'Change of variable id on add - {vid} to {added_uid}')
                            vid = added_uid
                            var.id = vid
                        var_uids.add(vid)
                    found_uids.add(vid)
            lost_vars = var_uids - found_uids
            if lost_vars:
                logger.info('Removing variables from project: %s', lost_vars)
                proj.delete_variable(list(lost_vars))

    class NewsegsProject(TableOwningNewsegsComponent, RecoverableInMemoryVariableProvider):
    """A container and controller for metamodels and variables."""

    _name = 'Untitled project'
    _version = 'v0.0.1'
    _id_prefix = COMPONENT_PREFIXES['project']

    _excluded_attributes = NewsegsComponent._excluded_attributes.union(
        {'_watcher', '_variables_by_uid', '_variables_by_varid'}
    )

    metamodels = TableModifyingComponentListProperty(oftype = newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel)
    dsa_config = ComponentProperty(default = DSAComponent, oftype = DSAComponent)
    psa_config = ComponentProperty(default = PSAComponent, oftype = PSAComponent)

    _focussed_metamodel: int = 0
    _watcher: RevisionNotifierProtocol | None = None

    @override
    def _generate_config(self, *args, **kwargs) -> NewsegsProjectConfig:
        return NewsegsProjectConfig(*args, **kwargs)
    _config: NewsegsProjectConfig # pyright: ignore[reportIncompatibleVariableOverride]

    def __init__(
        self,
        metamodels: Optional[Sequence[newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel]] = [],
        *args,
        default_variables: Optional[Sequence[Variable]] = [],
        dsa_config: Optional[DSAComponent] = None,
        psa_config: Optional[PSAComponent] = None,
        table_config: Optional[TableConfigNewsegsComponent] = None,
        **kwargs
    ):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        InMemoryVariableProvider.__init__(self, default_variables)

        self.table_config = table_config or TableConfigNewsegsComponent()
        self.watcher = ProjVarWatcher(self)
        self.dsa_config = dsa_config or DSAComponent()
        self.psa_config = psa_config or PSAComponent()

        self.metamodels = metamodels or []
        if len(self.metamodels):
            if not self.model_type == self.metamodels[0].model.model_type:
                if self.model_type == '':
                    self.model_type = self.metamodels[0].model.model_type
                else:
                    raise TypeError(f'First metamodel of incompatible type; Expected: {self.model_type}; received: {self.metamodels[0].model.model_type}')
            if not self.model_version == self.metamodels[0].model.version:
                if self.model_version == '':
                    self.model_version = self.metamodels[0].model.version
                else:
                    raise TypeError(f'First metamodel of incompatible version; Expected: {self.model_version}; received: {self.metamodels[0].model.version}')

    @property
    def metamodel_ids(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """The ids of the metamodels, in order.
        """
        return tuple(mm.id for mm in self.metamodels)

    @property
    def watcher(self) -> RevisionNotifierProtocol:
        """The watcher which tracks changes to the metamodels; created on first use.
        """
        if self._watcher is None:
            self._watcher = ProjVarWatcher(self)
        return self._watcher

    @watcher.setter
    def watcher(self, watcher: RevisionNotifierProtocol):
        self._watcher = watcher

    def get_focussed_metamodel_index(self) -> int:
        """The index of the focussed metamodel.

        The focussed metamodel is the one displayed and run by the app. Raises `ValueError` if the project has no metamodels.

        Returns:
            The index.
        """
        if self._focussed_metamodel >= len(self.metamodels):
            if len(self.metamodels) == 0:
                raise ValueError('No metamodels within project')
            else:
                self._focussed_metamodel = len(self.metamodels) - 1
        return self._focussed_metamodel

    def set_focussed_metamodel_index(self, metamodel_index: int = 0):
        """Set the focussed metamodel by index.

        Args:
            metamodel_index: Index of the metamodel within the project.
        """
        self.set_focussed_metamodel(metamodel_index = metamodel_index)

    def get_focussed_metamodel(self):
        """The focussed metamodel.

        Returns:
            The metamodel.
        """
        return self.metamodels[self.get_focussed_metamodel_index()]

    def set_focussed_metamodel(self, metamodel_id: Optional[str] = None, metamodel_index: int = 0):
        """Set the focussed metamodel by id or by index.

        The id is used if given and found; otherwise the index, limited to the metamodels available.

        Args:
            metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.
            metamodel_index: Index of the metamodel within the project.
        """
        if metamodel_id:
            for i, mm in enumerate(self.metamodels):
                if mm.id == metamodel_id:
                    self._focussed_metamodel = i
                    return
        self._focussed_metamodel = max(0, min(len(self.metamodels)-1, metamodel_index))

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `duplicate_metamodel` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def duplicate_metamodel(self, metamodel_id: str) -> newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel:
        """Add a copy of a metamodel, with new ids, to the project.

        Raises `ValueError` if the metamodel is not found.

        Args:
            metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.

        Returns:
            The copy.
        """
        try:
            wch = self.metamodel_ids.index(metamodel_id)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError(f'Metamodel not found: {metamodel_id}')
        mm = self.metamodels[wch]

        mm2 = copy.deepcopy(mm)
        mm2.anonymise_ids()

        self.metamodels.append(mm2) # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType, reportAttributeAccessIssue]
        return mm2 # pyright: ignore[reportReturnType]

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        cls = self.__class__
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        memo[id(self)] = result

        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded')
        state = self.__getstate__()
        cls.set_state_exclusion_policy('excluded_and_components')

        state = {k:copy.deepcopy(v, memo) for k, v in state.items()}

        result.__setstate__(state)

        # Reattach the metamodel variables from self, then add them to result,
        # then duplicate and reattach
        for mm in result.metamodels:
            mm.reattach_variables(self)

        #for var in mm.variables.values():
        #    self.add_variable(var)

        new_vars = []
        for varid, varlist in self._variables_by_varid.items():
            for uid, var in varlist.items():
                old_id = var.id
                new_var = copy.deepcopy(var)
                new_var.anonymise_ids()
                new_vars.append(new_var)
                for mm in result.metamodels:
                    if mm.variables[varid].id == old_id:
                        mm.variables[varid] = new_var
        result._variables_by_varid.clear()
        result._variables_by_uid.clear()
        for var in new_vars:
            result.add_variable(var)

        result.revision = self.revision
        result.table_config.revision = self.table_config.revision

        # Other id anonymisation should take place outside of the copy

        return result

    def reattach_metamodels(self, provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
        """Reattach the metamodels of a project after it has been reconstructed.

        The metamodels are found from the ids recorded when the project was serialised, and given the variables of the project. The revisions are preserved.

        Args:
            provider: Provider from which to recover the components.
        """
        if not hasattr(self, '_metamodel_ids') or not self._metamodel_ids:
            return
        r0 = self.revision
        tr0 = self.table_config.revision
        metamodels = provider.get_component(self._metamodel_ids)
        for i, mm in enumerate(metamodels):
            if not isinstance(mm, newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel):
                raise TypeError(f'Component provider did not return a metamodel for id {self._metamodel_ids[i]}, is {type(mm)}')
            mm.reattach_variables(self)
        self.metamodels = metamodels
        self.revision = r0
        self.table_config.revision = tr0

    def get_metamodel_by_id(self, metamodel_id: str):
        """Get a metamodel by id.

        Raises `KeyError` if it is not found.

        Args:
            metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.

        Returns:
            The metamodel.
        """
        for mm in self.metamodels:
            if mm.id == metamodel_id:
                break
        else:
            raise KeyError(f'Metamodel {metamodel_id} not found for project {self.name}[{self.id}] - available values are {[x.id for x in self.metamodels]}.')
        return mm

    @override
    def _prepare_object_state(self):
        super()._prepare_object_state()
        self._metamodel_ids = self.metamodel_ids
        vrus = dict()
        for k, v in self._variables_by_varid.items():
            vrus[k] = list(v.keys())

    # REVIEW (unreferenced): no references to `variable_to_store` found in src/, scripts/ or data/.
    def variable_to_store(
        self, 
        store_interface: VariablePersistenceInterface, 
        variable_id: Optional['str | SequenceNotStr[str]'] = None,
        force: bool = False,
    ):
        """Write variables of the project to a store.

        Args:
            store_interface: The store to which the variables are written.
            variable_id: Id(s) of the variable(s); all variables if None.
            force: Write the variables even if their revisions have not changed.
        """
        if isinstance(variable_id, str):
            variable_id = [variable_id, ]
        elif variable_id is None:
            variable_id = list(self._variables_by_uid.keys())

        vars = [self.get_variable(x) for x in variable_id]
        store_interface.upsert_variable(vars, force)

    @override
    def _preupdate_from_dict(self, config):
        super()._preupdate_from_dict(config)
        if not hasattr(self, '_variables_by_varid'):
            self._variables_by_varid = OrderedDict()
        if not hasattr(self, '_variables_by_uid'):
            self._variables_by_uid = dict()

    def get_focussed_metamodel_index(self) -> int:
    """The index of the focussed metamodel.

    The focussed metamodel is the one displayed and run by the app. Raises `ValueError` if the project has no metamodels.

    Returns:
        The index.
    """
    if self._focussed_metamodel >= len(self.metamodels):
        if len(self.metamodels) == 0:
            raise ValueError('No metamodels within project')
        else:
            self._focussed_metamodel = len(self.metamodels) - 1
    return self._focussed_metamodel

    def set_focussed_metamodel(self, metamodel_id: Optional[str] = None, metamodel_index: int = 0):
    """Set the focussed metamodel by id or by index.

    The id is used if given and found; otherwise the index, limited to the metamodels available.

    Args:
        metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.
        metamodel_index: Index of the metamodel within the project.
    """
    if metamodel_id:
        for i, mm in enumerate(self.metamodels):
            if mm.id == metamodel_id:
                self._focussed_metamodel = i
                return
    self._focussed_metamodel = max(0, min(len(self.metamodels)-1, metamodel_index))

    def duplicate_metamodel(self, metamodel_id: str) -> newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel:
    """Add a copy of a metamodel, with new ids, to the project.

    Raises `ValueError` if the metamodel is not found.

    Args:
        metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.

    Returns:
        The copy.
    """
    try:
        wch = self.metamodel_ids.index(metamodel_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f'Metamodel not found: {metamodel_id}')
    mm = self.metamodels[wch]

    mm2 = copy.deepcopy(mm)
    mm2.anonymise_ids()

    self.metamodels.append(mm2) # pyright: ignore[reportArgumentType, reportAttributeAccessIssue]
    return mm2 # pyright: ignore[reportReturnType]

    def reattach_metamodels(self, provider: NewsegsComponentProviderInterface):
    """Reattach the metamodels of a project after it has been reconstructed.

    The metamodels are found from the ids recorded when the project was serialised, and given the variables of the project. The revisions are preserved.

    Args:
        provider: Provider from which to recover the components.
    """
    if not hasattr(self, '_metamodel_ids') or not self._metamodel_ids:
        return
    r0 = self.revision
    tr0 = self.table_config.revision
    metamodels = provider.get_component(self._metamodel_ids)
    for i, mm in enumerate(metamodels):
        if not isinstance(mm, newsegsmetamodel.NewsegsMetaModel):
            raise TypeError(f'Component provider did not return a metamodel for id {self._metamodel_ids[i]}, is {type(mm)}')
        mm.reattach_variables(self)
    self.metamodels = metamodels
    self.revision = r0
    self.table_config.revision = tr0

    def get_metamodel_by_id(self, metamodel_id: str):
    """Get a metamodel by id.

    Raises `KeyError` if it is not found.

    Args:
        metamodel_id: Id of the metamodel.

    Returns:
        The metamodel.
    """
    for mm in self.metamodels:
        if mm.id == metamodel_id:
            break
    else:
        raise KeyError(f'Metamodel {metamodel_id} not found for project {self.name}[{self.id}] - available values are {[x.id for x in self.metamodels]}.')
    return mm
